name: Höllentaleingangshütte
kurzbeschreibung: **Hell Valley Entrance Hut in Tirol** – a cozy mountain refuge nestled at the gateway to the dramatic **Höllental** (Hell Valley), where sheer cliffs and cascading waterfalls create a breathtaking alpine spectacle. Just a short hike from **Innsbruck**, this rustic hut offers hearty **Tiroler** hospitality, with panoramic views over jagged peaks and emerald-green valleys. Perfect for hikers seeking adventure or those craving a peaceful retreat in the heart of the **Zillertal Alps**. --- **Highlights:** - **Höllentalangerhütte** (Hell Valley Long Hut) – a legendary staging post for daring climbers. - **Höllentalferner** (Hell Valley Glacier) – a stunning ice field accessible via a thrilling via ferrata. - **Nordkette** – iconic cable car rides with jaw-dropping vistas over **Innsbruck** and beyond. - **Kaiserschmarrn** and **Apfelstrudel** – sweet treats to refuel after a day of exploration. --- **Tip:** Start early to avoid crowds and catch the golden-hour glow over the **Karwendel** and **Mieminger Chain** ranges. Don’t miss the **Höllentalbahn** (Hell Valley Railway) for a scenic ride to the valley floor! --- **More info** | **Discover Innsbruck**
